line: Sim simma, let me get my keys
vault_lines: Sim simma, let me get my keys (Pluggz)
meaning: Reference to Beenie Man’s 1997 dancehall classic “Who Am I”, where he asks in the chorus “Sim-simma, who got di keys to my Bimma?”

vault_lines: Sim simma, let me get my keys (Pluggz)
meaning: This is one of the iconic “Plug!” producer tags of the collective “BeatPluggz”, a pioneering Atlanta-based music producer collective founded in 2013 by MexikoDro and StoopidXool. They created the “plugg” subgenre of trap music, famous for its minimalist synths and chilled-out melodies from VST’s like Purity, ElectraX, and Nexus
